name: Algebraic_Threshold_Obfuscation
description: Replaces the explicit graph-theoretic edge condition ("both endpoints in set") with a locally computed algebraic formula `floor((Pu + Pv)/2)` whose sum over all edges equals the target `m` if and only if the independent set condition holds. This prevents keyword-based mapping to Independent Set and requires the model to analytically deduce the forbidden subgraph structure from the algebraic bounds.
